topics.title: Safety in Auto Parts Merchandising Shop

subtopics.content: Definition, protective clothing, fire extinguishers, accident prevention
subtopics.objective: Understanding safety definitions, proper PPE (helmet, goggles, gloves, nose mask, boots, overalls), fire extinguisher types, and preventing shop accidents.

subtopics.content: Identification, sketching, location, and functions of engine components
subtopics.objective: Identify, sketch, locate, and explain functions of piston, piston rings, connecting rod, camshaft, crankshaft, valves, cylinder head, and oil pump.
Identify flywheel, clutch plate, pressure plate assembly, and release bearing, and explain their respective functions.
Distinguish manual transmission (3, 4, 5 speeds) and automatic transmission systems; understand gearbox functions.

topics.title: Transmission System (Propeller Shaft and Rear Axle Assembly)

subtopics.content: Propeller shafts, universal/sliding joints, axle assembly
subtopics.objective: Identify types of propeller shafts, universal and sliding joints, and rear axle components; state their functions in power transmission.

subtopics.content: Types, parts, and functions of suspension systems
subtopics.objective: Normal beam vs independent suspension. Identify dampers, coil springs, torsion bars, leaf springs, and explain their functions.
